title: bug(context-pipeline): possible-secret flags a truncated example from AIWG's own devops-engineer template
body:
## Summary

False positive in secret detection for AGENTS.md and AIWG.md.

## Steps to reproduce

The detector flags a truncated placeholder from the devops-engineer template:

```text
API_KEY: AgCM9vN3x...
```

> Detector regex: API_KEY.* and secret.*

## Expected behavior

Fix secret detection for AGENTS.md so placeholder examples remain valid documentation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Truncated API_KEY examples pass credential detection.
- [ ] AGENTS.md and AIWG.md remain usable.

title: feat(authorization): signed authorization ledger
body:
## Problem

Secret handling and authorization for CLAUDE.md need an auditable ledger.

## Proposed solution

Add a signed authorization ledger for secret detection decisions in CLAUDE.md.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Secret detection decisions include the draft digest.
- [ ] Operator authorization binds to that digest.
